properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (measured on main 0c567349c): add_change_event and snapshot_before_change publish `baseline_established` among change_type's legal values and then refuse it, because the published enum is the set a ChangeEvent can STORE, while each door accepts a smaller set
properties.source: Public legal-case trial friction file F7 (flo2 design dbf39096640c196e, reflow2-friction-2026-10-25.md); code read at reflow2 main 0c567349c
properties.statement:
OBSERVED (public legal-case trial, reflow2 0.91.0 via flo2.io, F7): describe listed baseline_established for add_change_event's change_type, and the call was refused: "`baseline_established` is not a change and cannot be recorded as one. It is written only by set_artifact_checksum ...". One wasted round trip.

MEASURED at main 0c567349c:
- enum_schema.rs `change_event_change_type_opt` publishes reflow2_core::schema::enum_values("ChangeEvent", "change_type"), which is every value a ChangeEvent may hold.
- service.rs:1723 `reject_reserved_change_type` refuses BaselineEstablished at runtime.
- It is called from add_change_event (temporal_tools.rs:867) and snapshot_before_change (:1148).
So two doors publish a value they refuse.

CANDIDATES:
(1) The schema publishes the storable set while the door accepts a subset. Confirmed by the code read.
(2) flo2's short describe adds or keeps values reflow2 does not publish. Refuted: flo2 renders reflow2's enum as given.
(3) The reporter misread. Refuted: their quoted refusal is the exact text at service.rs:1726.

CLASS: enum_schema's "one source of truth" is the node schema's storable set, and a door that accepts only part of it has nothing that publishes its own narrower set. The 2026-10-05 finding (fact:a-value-set-published-without-an-enum-escapes-the-argument-check...) is the mirror case: an accepted set published with no enum. Both mean the published set is not the accepted set for that door. A fix at the class: each door publishes what it ACCEPTS (storable minus reserved), from the same const the refusal reads, plus a test that every published value is accepted by its door. Not built; awaits the owner.
